data.gender_notes: Georgiana is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Georgios, meaning 'farmer' or 'earthworker'. In the Christian tradition, St. George is a revered martyr who is said to have slain a dragon, symbolizing the triumph of good over evil. The name Georgiana carries the meaning “George's farmer or earthworker” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Georgiana usually hope their child will grow to embody george's farmer or earthworker and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Georgiana total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
